findings.summary: Nineteen frozen baseline rows attribute non-empty allergen arrays to official ingredients/allergen-menu evidence but retain only a Nutritionix URL. That third-party source must not be promoted to restaurant-issued evidence; the currently reopened official guide does not supply replacement complete arrays.

Luna reported zero current products, but the current official Nutrition Guide visibly lists products absent from the frozen snapshot, including Love Potion #31 Pre-Packed Quart, Black Walnut, OREO Brookie Batter 2 Scoop Sundae, and M&M'S with Cookie Dough Cake in a Box. The guide and ordering surface still do not establish a complete selected-shop catalog.

The official Nutrition Guide warns that restaurants prepare and serve products containing allergens other than the products selected. It is a global warning, not an item-specific may-contain array; no item-level cross-contact conclusion may be inferred.

summary: Independent verification found a material source-authority discrepancy and missed current products. Every scout surface was reopened once; Luna had no current products or presentation IDs to re-check. The official PDF confirms a partial current product boundary and a global cross-contact warning, but it cannot support complete allergen arrays, negatives, item-specific may-contain arrays, or a complete national/shop catalog. All 80 frozen keys were reconciled exactly once as location-scoped/unavailable pending a selected-shop catalog and authoritative item-level allergen source.
